subject: Money
title: Herd Behavior
description: A short lesson to help you apply Herd Behavior.

hook.text: In 2021, GameStop stock rose 1,500% in two weeks. Most buyers had never read a financial statement.

buildup.text: Herd behavior: people follow the crowd because everyone else can't be wrong. Social proof replaces analysis.

discovery.text: The mechanism is FOMO: fear of missing out. When your neighbor doubles their money, sitting out feels like losing.

twist.text: Herds amplify both buying and selling. The same crowd that pushes prices up causes stampede selling during crashes.

climax.text: Rational individuals become irrational groups. The psychology of crowds is the engine of every bubble.

punchline.text: Follow the crowd up. Follow them down.

quiz.question: What primarily drives herd behavior in financial markets?
